Hey folks 👋🏻👋🏻

I wrote a report covering the entire Ethereum roadmap!

https://herccc.substack.com/p/the-ethereum-roadmap

The merge, the surge, the scourge, the verge, the purge, and the splurge are all covered. It’s super long, and will take a while to read at once, so I would recommend reading it in parts and using the report as a reference point for whatever sections interest you. 

Thanks! Enjoy 🙂
